abilities.name: Our Minds as One
abilities.text: While this Unit's Current Supply Value is 2, it gains the following effects: The first Special Ability resolved by this Unit each Round has its PE cost reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Apply a +1 Modifier to the dice rolled for its Psionic Storm Special Ability.

abilities.name: Feedback
abilities.text: Target one Enemy Mechanical or Psionic Unit Within 8". Until the End of the Round, after that Unit resolves an Active or Reaction Special Ability (excluding abilities granted by a Tactical Card or Faction Card), it suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (3).

upgrades.name: Psionic Storm
upgrades.text: Set a Psionic Storm token Within 10" and Line of Sight of this Unit. This token is not removed if this Unit is Destroyed. At the End of each Phase, set a Psionic Storm Blast Template on the centre of this token. For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially covered by the template, roll 3 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially covered. For each result of 5+, that Unit suffers an effect depending on the current Phase: Movement Phase: NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1). Assault Phase: 1 Damage. If multiple effects trigger at the End of the Assault Phase, resolve them in the order specified in Part 8.9.4.

upgrades.name: Farsight
upgrades.text: Target one Friendly Unit Within 12". Until the End of the Round, that Unit is eligible to make an Evade Roll against any attacks targeting it.

notes: Provisional: transcribed from a preview, not the printed card. Faction tags, combat role and base size are not shown in the preview.

The preview shows Models/Supply 1→0 and 2→1 and prices of 130/230; the 10.6 Unit Cost Table (09.10.2026) lists 2 models 120 (Supply 1) and 4 models 200 (Supply 2). The table is used, and the 3-4 → Supply 2 bracket is inferred from it.
